source_of_truth: Operator-stated requirement (2026-06-21): `dontpanic doctor` checks instance health but is not a changelog-aware upgrade assistant — it cannot tell a user who updated across releases what changed, what operator actions are required vs advisory, whether migrations (canonical-discovery backfill) were needed/completed, or which new CLI surfaces landed. The locked design (decisions D001-D009): a structured release manifest docs/upgrade/releases.json is the machine contract for upgrade intent (NOT prose CHANGELOG, NOT the plan ledger); detection probes are the sole authority for required-action satisfaction; a per-instance marker ~/.dontpanic/upgrade-state.json records last-seen/dismissed; the surface is inside doctor (--upgrade, --upgrade --json, --acknowledge); v0 is detect + explain + copyable commands with NO mutation.
completion_test: Done when, on an instance whose marker predates the seeded releases, `dontpanic doctor --upgrade --json` emits required[]/advisory[]/migration_status[] sourced from docs/upgrade/releases.json with exact copyable commands; the canonical-discovery REQUIRED item reflects a live detection probe (the registered_active outcome; a stale/invalid evidence file does not block it, D019) rather than the marker; plain `dontpanic doctor` shows exactly one WARN with the remediation command while actions are pending; and `dontpanic doctor --upgrade --acknowledge` advances the marker and silences advisories but a required action whose probe still fails remains listed as pending.

user_journeys.name: operator-updates-and-sees-what-to-run
user_journeys.description: An operator pulls a newer DontPanic, runs `dontpanic doctor`, sees a concise WARN that N upgrade actions are pending with the remediation command, then runs `dontpanic doctor --upgrade` and gets a coherent checklist of required vs advisory changes since their last-acknowledged point, each with an exact copyable command and a probe-backed status. Nothing is mutated by doctor.
acceptance_signals: Plain `dontpanic doctor` emits exactly one WARN CheckResult with 'run: dontpanic doctor --upgrade' and the pending_required/pending_advisory counts when actions pend

`dontpanic doctor --upgrade` leads with a version/update summary line: installed_commit, latest_release_id, last_seen_release, pending_required, pending_advisory, update_state, plus an upstream block (fetched_upstream_commit, upstream_status, remediation) answering 'am I behind the newest DontPanic?' without a network fetch by default
Plain doctor and --upgrade are read-only: they never create or mutate ~/.dontpanic/upgrade-state.json (only --acknowledge/dismiss writes)
Required-action commands are an ordered preview->apply->verify sequence, not a single opaque command

`dontpanic doctor --upgrade` lists required[] and advisory[] derived from docs/upgrade/releases.json, each with why (detail), whether-it-applies (applies_when), exact command, and success/failure copy

`dontpanic doctor --upgrade --json` emits {summary:{installed_commit, latest_release_id, last_seen_release, update_state, pending_required, pending_advisory}, required[], advisory[], migration_status[]}
doctor performs no backfill/migration/config write (no-mutation invariant)

user_journeys.name: required-action-clears-only-when-probe-passes
user_journeys.description: The canonical-discovery required action is shown pending while the instance is not yet registered_active (or backfill evidence is missing/invalid). The operator runs the suggested command out-of-band; on the next doctor run the probe passes and the action clears. Acknowledging WITHOUT running the command does not clear it.
acceptance_signals: canonical_discovery_registered_active returns satisfied=true when DontPanic reconciles to registered_active; a stale/invalid evidence file does not block the proven outcome (D019)
A required action with an unsatisfied probe is reported pending regardless of marker state
`--acknowledge` advances last_seen_release/commit and silences advisories but the probe-failing required action is STILL pending afterward
Probe fail-closed: when status cannot be determined the action stays pending with an explanatory detail

user_journeys.name: dashboard-shows-persistent-update-status
user_journeys.description: The dashboard shows a persistent version/update-readiness status signal (a Tools & Setup / Health row) so update state is obvious at a glance — including the positive 'up to date' case — with ActionItems as the drill-down rather than the only signal.
acceptance_signals: A persistent status row renders update_state + pending counts, e.g. 'DontPanic: up to date' / 'DontPanic: 2 upgrade actions pending' / 'Last acknowledged: 2026-06-17 (commit abc1234)'
The status row is present in the up-to-date case (positive confirmation), not only when actions pend
A probe-pending required action emits an ActionItem with band=needs_action and its exact_command (drill-down)
An undismissed advisory emits band=advisory; dismissed/satisfied items are absent or info
ActionItem ids are stable (upgrade:<release>:<action>) and deterministically sorted for dedup
Status projection + action_view projection contain no secret shapes

user_journeys.name: after-git-pull-end-to-end
user_journeys.description: The full operator journey after updating: an instance whose marker predates the seeded releases (or has no marker) runs plain `dontpanic doctor` and gets a WARN with pending counts, then `dontpanic doctor --upgrade` for the full report led by the version/update summary; after the required action is satisfied out-of-band the next run clears it and update_state transitions. This journey is captured as required evidence.
acceptance_signals: From a behind/absent marker, plain doctor WARNs with pending_required>0
--upgrade --json shows the summary + the canonical-discovery required action pending with its exact command

After the status_probe becomes satisfied, a re-run clears the required action and plain doctor no longer WARNs for it; update_state transitions (e.g. required_pending -> up_to_date/advisories_pending)
First-run does NOT flood advisories: only show_on_first_run advisories appear on a fresh marker while required actions remain probe-driven
The captured live --upgrade --json and the journey transcript are persisted under evidence/

required_evidence: test_output for manifest schema/loader validation incl the full action field set and show_on_first_run (F001)
test_output for the canonical-discovery status_probe across registered_active / stale / missing / unresolved / error states + has_tracked_projects applies_when (F003)
test_output for the first-run policy (no advisory flood; required actions still probe-driven) (F004)
test_output for the version/update summary contract incl update_state matrix and off-git installed_commit=unknown (F005)
test_output proving --acknowledge does not clear a probe-failing required action (F004/F005)
test_output for the dashboard update-status row across up_to_date / pending / last-acknowledged states (F006)
an end-to-end 'after git pull' journey: fresh-update -> doctor WARN -> full report -> probe satisfied -> action clears + update_state transition, with the journey transcript persisted (F008)
a live `dontpanic doctor --upgrade --json` capture on the real instance showing the canonical-discovery item reflecting the real probe result (F005/F008)
non_goals: Auto-running backfills, migrations, or config writes (no mutation in v0)
Deriving upgrade actions from the plan ledger or by grepping CHANGELOG prose
Blocking (hard-gating) on manifest/CHANGELOG drift in v0
Writing the upgrade-state marker from any path except --acknowledge/dismiss (no silent marker writes on plain doctor)
Performing a network git fetch by default (upstream_status is read from existing remote-tracking refs; an explicit --check-upstream may opt in)
Seeding manifest entries for CHANGELOG sections at/before the baseline (v0 coverage = selected seed releases + all future manifest-authored releases)
Coupling required-action satisfaction to a stale evidence file when the outcome probe already proves completion
